stages.title: Current foundation
stages.description: Active expansion on existing evidence, evaluation, reporting, and delivery substrates.

stages.title: Near term
stages.description: The next bounded capabilities enabled by the current foundation.

stages.title: Mid term
stages.description: Program-level product and scientific systems with broader dependencies.

stages.title: Future direction
stages.description: A research direction without a calendar commitment.

initiatives.title: Frozen leakage-resistant evaluation cohorts
initiatives.outcome: Bind published evaluation claims to stable cohorts, explicit denominators, and leakage-resistant holdouts.

details.currentFoundation: De-leak correction, canonical validation report, versioned artifacts, and documented split-governance direction.
details.primaryUserValue: Trust that published metrics refer to a stable, inspectable evaluation target.
details.dependencies: Frozen manifests, source split reconstruction, scaffold IDs, temporal partitions, baselines, and promotion policy.
details.validationGate: Reproducible cohort reconstruction, disjointness audits, leakage checks, and immutable result binding.
details.claimBoundary: A development cohort is not an untouched independent test, and artifact hashes are not scientific accuracy.

initiatives.title: Reproducible reports and publication workflows
initiatives.outcome: Make analyses reproducible, inspectable, shareable, and easier to challenge.

details.currentFoundation: Versioned model/KG identity, structured reports, evidence support bundles, and API contracts.
details.primaryUserValue: Make computational hypotheses easier to reproduce, review, share, cite, and challenge.
details.dependencies: Export formats, report versioning, stable identifiers, diffing, citation formatting, figure/table generation, and access controls.
details.validationGate: A saved report must be reconstructable from its bound inputs and artifacts within the supported reproducibility contract.
details.claimBoundary: Reproducible execution does not guarantee scientific correctness, and strict cross-hardware bitwise identity should not be promised without audit.

initiatives.title: Versioned research APIs and agent infrastructure
initiatives.outcome: Expose versioned, evidence-preserving research capabilities through stable APIs and agent-safe contracts.

details.currentFoundation: Endpoint-rich known- and novel-route APIs, independently requestable sections, evidence artifacts, subgraphs, and bundles.
details.primaryUserValue: Let machines request only the scientific capability and evidence needed for a workflow.
details.dependencies: Stable versioning, authentication, identity, metering, quotas, service contracts, agent-safe schemas, higher-level comparative endpoints, and reproducibility guarantees.
details.validationGate: Contract tests, route parity, schema stability, evidence preservation, deterministic artifact identity within the supported environment, and agent-workflow evaluation.
details.claimBoundary: Do not claim current autonomous-agent adoption, MCP availability, x402 payments, or comparative endpoints unless separately verified and approved.

initiatives.title: NeuroLab Atlas Tier
initiatives.outcome: Offer a curated library of precomputed, versioned compound reports for public exploration.

details.currentFoundation: Existing structured known-compound reports, granular report sections, evidence artifacts, model and knowledge-graph version identity, and the current multi-stage human application.
details.primaryUserValue: Replace a static landing-page demo with a credible, self-directed product experience that reduces uncertainty about what a paid Neurolab analysis contains.
details.dependencies: Public-report schema; compound selection and editorial criteria; artifact sanitization; report, model, graph, and evidence version binding; object storage and CDN delivery; searchable metadata index; entitlement boundaries; upgrade flows; rate limits; abuse monitoring; accessibility; and product analytics.
details.validationGate: Public reports reproduce against their bound artifacts; displayed evidence and uncertainty remain traceable; search and sorting use declared fields; no private or restricted data is exposed; and cache delivery does not bypass access-control boundaries.
details.claimBoundary: Do not imply that the free tier exposes the complete knowledge graph, all known compounds, unrestricted evidence bundles, live custom inference, or the full capabilities of paid tiers. Do not claim a final catalog size until the public set is approved.

initiatives.title: Expanded molecular pharmacology
initiatives.outcome: Improve compound, target, action, exposure, and uncertainty representations across inference routes.

details.currentFoundation: Existing compound-target, action, dosage, evidence, and provenance layers.
details.primaryUserValue: More accurate and context-aware hypotheses about what a compound can plausibly engage.
details.dependencies: Licensed sources, identity resolution, relation semantics, quantitative normalization, contradictory-evidence handling, exposure data, and curation.
details.validationGate: Source- and context-specific audits; separation of binding, functional action, exposure, and engagement; retrieval tests against held-out evidence.
details.claimBoundary: Binding must not be silently equated with functional action, exposure, occupancy, or brain effect.

initiatives.title: Improved novel-structure inference
initiatives.outcome: Expand reliable coverage of unfamiliar chemistry while surfacing applicability and uncertainty.

details.currentFoundation: Structure-to-receptor retrieval, analog search, route-aware reasoning, applicability fields, and abstention.
details.primaryUserValue: Investigate candidate structures before they are richly represented in the KG.
details.dependencies: Identified evaluation cohorts, chemical representation work, receptor/action data, applicability curves, sign uncertainty, and downstream route validation.
details.validationGate: Receptor recovery, scaffold-disjoint evaluation, accuracy-versus-coverage curves, functional-action evaluation, end-to-end downstream validation, and failure-case tests.
details.claimBoundary: Candidate targets and discriminating experiments should replace definitive mechanisms when structural evidence is insufficient.

initiatives.title: Calibrated head-specific evaluation
initiatives.outcome: Evaluate each model output against its own frozen cohort, baseline, and confidence semantics.

details.currentFoundation: Canonical route-separated validation report and explicit refusal to publish one overall accuracy.
details.primaryUserValue: Understand which output is ready for which research use.
details.dependencies: Frozen cohorts, denominators, baselines, confidence semantics, calibration methods, and route-specific reporting.
details.validationGate: Reproducible metrics, confidence intervals where appropriate, selective-risk curves, independent or prospective slices, and documented blocked claims.
details.claimBoundary: Do not average heterogeneous heads or present development evidence as untouched independent validation.

initiatives.title: Calibration and selective-risk analysis
initiatives.outcome: Show when the system should answer, narrow a claim, or abstain through calibration and selective-risk analysis.

details.currentFoundation: Explicit route-specific confidence, applicability, and abstention fields.
details.primaryUserValue: Know when to trust a shortlist, request more evidence, or stop.
details.dependencies: Frozen cohorts, honest confidence semantics, risk curves, thresholds, and out-of-domain slices.
details.validationGate: Accuracy-versus-coverage curves, threshold stability, false-confidence audits, and prospective monitoring.
details.claimBoundary: Applicability status, similarity, or seed stability is not automatically a calibrated probability of correctness.

initiatives.title: Comparative compound intelligence
initiatives.outcome: Compare compounds and cohorts through shared evidence-aware analysis without implying automated candidate selection.

details.currentFoundation: Individual known- and novel-compound inference; structured reports; granular API surfaces.
details.primaryUserValue: Compare candidates using the same compound-to-brain lens rather than reading isolated reports.
details.dependencies: Batch orchestration, route-aware normalization, missing-data policy, applicability handling, comparison semantics, ranking policy, and program-level UI/API design.
details.validationGate: Demonstrate that comparisons remain meaningful across differing evidence states and inference routes; prospectively test whether the workflow improves research prioritization.
details.claimBoundary: Do not claim that batch inference, comparative ranking, or program dashboards are currently available. Do not imply automated winner selection.

initiatives.title: Industrialized evidence acquisition
initiatives.outcome: Scale the conversion of primary studies into provenance-bound, reviewable observations.

details.currentFoundation: Provenance records, evidence bundles, source policies, and report pointers.
details.primaryUserValue: Faster growth of reviewable evidence without losing scientific context.
details.dependencies: Literature discovery, document access, extraction, normalization, ontology mapping, methods/results localization, reviewer workflow, admission criteria, and source versioning.
details.validationGate: Extraction precision and recall; context completeness; contradiction and null capture; inter-reviewer agreement; tamper and provenance checks; source-family holdouts.
details.claimBoundary: Automated extraction accelerates candidate evidence processing; it does not make every extracted observation scientifically admissible without review.

initiatives.title: Reusable validated mechanistic islands
initiatives.outcome: Build deeply validated mechanistic subsystems that can be composed without claiming universal causal coverage.

details.currentFoundation: CircuitFramework, validation contracts, protected examples, and route-specific reasoners.
details.primaryUserValue: Build trustworthy mechanistic coverage incrementally instead of claiming unconstrained whole-brain reasoning.
details.dependencies: Selection of initial systems, expert curation, fixtures, source-independent evidence, reasoner contracts, and promotion criteria.
details.validationGate: Each island passes its own frozen context, null, contradiction, provenance, and abstention gates before reuse.
details.claimBoundary: Validation of one island does not validate all systems, compounds, contexts, or downstream outputs.

initiatives.title: NeuroLab Data Studio and persistent research workspaces
initiatives.outcome: Turn saved inference outputs into persistent, queryable workspaces for cross-run and cross-cohort analysis.

details.currentFoundation: Structured known- and novel-compound reports, independently addressable report sections, versioned model and knowledge-graph identity, evidence-linked artifacts, and granular API surfaces.
details.primaryUserValue: Move from isolated reports to a living, searchable research dataset that supports portfolio-level prioritization, longitudinal analysis, and reusable scientific inquiry.
details.dependencies: Persistent workspace and project identity; individual- and batch-output storage; route-aware normalized schemas; stable metric definitions; cohort tagging; query and ranking infrastructure; visualization and drilldown components; report, model, graph, and evidence version binding; permissions and tenant isolation; exports; and API parity.
details.validationGate: Saved queries and views reproduce against their bound dataset; rankings use declared metrics and deterministic transformations; cohort membership and filters are auditable; version or route incompatibilities are surfaced; uncertainty and abstentions remain visible; and generated interpretations cite the exact selected data.
details.claimBoundary: Do not claim that persistent workspaces, cross-cohort analytics, dashboards, metric ranking, or hypothesis generation are currently implemented. Do not describe rankings as automated candidate selection or hypotheses as validated findings.

initiatives.title: Enriched 392-parcel representation
initiatives.outcome: Connect the current parcel representation to richer nuclei, cell, receptor, network, and tract context.

details.currentFoundation: Current 392-parcel representation, nuclei, network, receptor-density, tract, and brain-explorer assets.
details.primaryUserValue: More precise anatomical navigation and better-scoped brain-system hypotheses.
details.dependencies: Atlas crosswalks, resolution preservation, source licensing, tract/cell integration, and visualization.
details.validationGate: Cross-atlas mapping accuracy, resolution-aware uncertainty, source provenance, and no silent coordinate equivalence.
details.claimBoundary: Richer anatomy does not establish compound exposure, functional direction, or measured effect.

initiatives.title: Independent and prospective validation
initiatives.outcome: Test priority capabilities against independent evidence and prospective experiments with predefined endpoints.

details.currentFoundation: Research triage outputs, evidence-linked hypotheses, and documented blocked claims.
details.primaryUserValue: Establish whether prioritized hypotheses survive new evidence and experiments.
details.dependencies: Partners, study selection, preregistration, experimental design, funding, data return, and publication policy.
details.validationGate: Predefined prospective endpoints, comparator methods, blinded review where possible, and transparent negative results.
details.claimBoundary: Do not imply prospective validation exists until studies are completed and results are available.

initiatives.title: Molecular-to-distributed-network hypotheses
initiatives.outcome: Explore how molecular hypotheses may connect to cells, circuits, pathways, and distributed networks.

details.currentFoundation: Receptor hypotheses, CircuitFramework, parcel/network representations, and separate density/circuit channels.
details.primaryUserValue: Explore how local molecular hypotheses might connect to distributed systems.
details.dependencies: Validated mechanistic islands, directed tracts, cell operators, observation models, context, and benchmark data.
details.validationGate: Source- and compound-disjoint tests, pathway ablations, network-level benchmarks, uncertainty, and explicit measured-versus-inferred labels.
details.claimBoundary: Regional maps must distinguish measured observations, predictions, anatomical opportunities, reference priors, and unresolved hypotheses.
